web.name: 浅色协作工作台
web.screen: single flat desktop UI, 16:10 landscape; no device hardware; readable Chinese
web.shell: 220px left sidebar, current acting-party selector, breadcrumb, task-focused main surface, no self-granting role switch

type.family: PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei / system sans-serif

invariants: 53px app top bar + 16px side padding; primary controls >=44px touch area
One explicit primary action per task region; no glowing orb or excessive badges
Unknown business values remain blank or pending; no fake fixed package prices
Account/party identifiers use copy controls, not invented names or photos
No unsupported live search, total counts, timecode feedback, payment success or public private assets
No brand logos invented differently on each page: use simple text 晶晶日上
Only top-level App screens carry the five bottom tabs; child pages use back navigation
No API paths, PR numbers or technical implementation notes inside the product UI
Pictures are static fictional illustrative assets; do not imply people or services exist in APIs
